concepts.title: Risk Pattern Specification
concepts.authored_definition: A managed, reusable information specification of risk-relevant conditions and possible effects. Its identity is distinct from a particular risk case, a scenario execution and the uncertain effects themselves.
concepts.rationale: The reusable pattern remains a documentary specialization. The comparison with intended steps is useful context, not a requirement that every pattern express an intention or be an execution plan.
concepts.context_interpretation: RX-002 links a continuing analytical case to its pattern; it does not identify the two. The inherited documentary identity and excluded blanket artifact set do not supply a Plan equivalence or register-approval condition.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Risk Context Specification
concepts.authored_definition: A versioned information specification of analysis boundaries, circumstances, time horizon and objective references under which risk statements and results are interpreted.
concepts.rationale: The context specification retains boundaries, horizon and objective references. Generic entity context does not supply that schema or its version policy.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-35/RX-001 now refer to the explicitly analytical RiskCase. Missing task inputs concern readiness under a declared profile, not nonexistence or formal admission of that case.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Risk Scenario Specification
concepts.authored_definition: A managed information specification of a possible development of conditions, events and effects concerning one or more RiskCases. Several scenarios may concern one case; a scenario is not the case or an actual occurrence.
concepts.rationale: Retain a bounded analogy to the security scenario entry. Riskium describes possible developments about continuing cases, with a broader stated risk scope.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-36 separates a scenario from its analytical case and R-25 does not turn a specification into an actual occurrence. Inherited artifact identity remains documentary, without blanket sibling exclusion.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Risk Nature Assertion
concepts.authored_definition: A source-qualified information assertion that possible or reported effects are favorable, unfavorable or mixed relative to identified objectives and context.
concepts.rationale: Retain contextual classification as a related use. The compared classifying term is a motivation instance, not the class of RiskNatureAssertion or proof of favorable/unfavorable meaning.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-41/R-42/R-43 keep the claim about a case, selected nature value and context separate. The analytical case reading leaves nature objective-relative; the claim does not establish truth by classification.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Nature Term
concepts.authored_definition: A controlled value used to qualify the nature of effects relative to objectives; it does not classify risk independently of context. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain the resource/label distinction. A NatureTerm is a controlled scheme-qualified vocabulary resource, whose wording alone does not determine its identity.
concepts.context_interpretation: The path through ClassificationTerm and VocabularyConcept preserves InformationArtifact identity. The retained GS-RKM-C019/GS-RKM-C017 groups are non-disjoint and incomplete; their source labels remain carried, not independently validated here.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Vocabulary Concept
concepts.authored_definition: A managed terminological information artifact that identifies a vocabulary meaning independently of its labels. It is a vocabulary resource, not automatically a domain universal or the real-world entity denoted.
concepts.rationale: Retain vocabulary-concept and lexical-label context. A Riskium vocabulary resource is not automatically its referent or an OWL domain universal; the source also permits dual typing, so no global disjointness is inferred.
concepts.context_interpretation: G2-052 preserves documentary identity and the explicit GS-RKM-C017 policy does not make its listed subtypes exhaustive. Excluding the blanket artifact set leaves these subtype edges intact.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Classification Scheme
concepts.authored_definition: A governed organization of classification concepts with an identified scope and version policy.
concepts.rationale: Retain the concept-scheme comparison without asserting identical extension. Scope, governance and version policy are additional Riskium commitments.
concepts.context_interpretation: GX-049 preserves artifact identity. R-05 records term membership under this profile; it is not a claim that the external scheme is closed or that the listed terms exhaust every possible member.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Classification Term
concepts.authored_definition: A managed vocabulary item expressing a controlled classification value within an identified scheme. Scheme membership and version context constrain its interpretation. This is a managed vocabulary resource with scheme-qualified identity, not a bare string.
concepts.rationale: Retain the controlled-resource/label distinction. The selected scheme and version context qualify a classification value; lexical equality is not a universal or resource identity rule.
concepts.context_interpretation: G2-053/G2-052 preserve the inherited documentary identity. GS-RKM-C019 and GS-RKM-C017 remain explicitly non-disjoint and incomplete; no new covering, exclusivity or semantic-module claim is added.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Classification Assertion
concepts.authored_definition: A source-qualified assignment of a classification term to a subject in a specified context.
concepts.rationale: Retain the distinction between a classification statement and its target. Annotation and classifying motivation inform this comparison without supplying Riskium source/context qualification or a formal class alignment.
concepts.context_interpretation: R-03 can classify an analytically identified RiskCase before organizational register admission. R-04/R-29 keep the selected term and documenting entry separate from the case and assertion.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Tag
concepts.authored_definition: A managed annotation artifact carrying a lightweight label. Identical lexical labels do not by themselves identify one tag assignment or imply a formal taxonomy.
concepts.rationale: Retain tagging motivation and lexical-label context. The motivation instance is distinct from a Riskium tag artifact; identical words do not identify an assignment or imply a formal taxonomy.
concepts.context_interpretation: G2-054 preserves artifact identity and R-24 links the tag to an entry revision. Excluding blanket artifact sibling grouping neither merges tags with classification terms nor makes all document types exclusive.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

concepts.title: Risk Source Reference
concepts.authored_definition: A managed information artifact identifying or describing a claimed contributor to risk in a declared context. The referenced contributor may be unresolved, hypothetical or heterogeneous. The reference does not establish actual causation or an actual occurrence.
concepts.rationale: Retain the document/referent contrast. A managed contributor reference may describe an unresolved or hypothetical contributor; it is not that contributor or evidence of actual causation.
concepts.context_interpretation: G3-001 supplies documentary identity. RK3-001 concerns an analytical RiskCase; RK3-002 is the distinct source-resolution link and RK3-003 supplies context. No universal bearer category or operational-admission requirement is introduced.
concepts.review_method: Assistant-supported selected primary-passage comparison plus explicit source ancestry, changed-neighbor and set-policy review; no independent expert rating.

boundaries.prior_source_policy: The historical source has no explicit generalization_set_policy field. This absence is not reconstructed as an asserted old logical set policy.
boundaries.focal_context: Current GS-RKM-C014 is explicitly excluded; preserve its subtype edges and distinguish documentary specialization from contextual evidential participation.
boundaries.retained_sets: The carried GS-RKM-C017/GS-RKM-C019 source statuses are not upgraded to independent semantic approval.
boundaries.semantic_review: Independent semantic judgment remains #23; exact normative adoption remains #78.
boundaries.deployment_scope: Previews are planning artifacts; full component qualification and publication/readback remain later gates.

batch_findings: All eleven authored definitions and local edge records are unchanged. InformationArtifact has a revised typing rationale in every selected ancestor context. Six selected concepts have the revised RiskCase as a direct association neighbor. Current policy excludes the blanket artifact set while retaining subtype edges; the retained GS-RKM-C017/GS-RKM-C019 groups remain non-disjoint, incomplete and explicitly carried rather than independently reapproved.

Vocabulary resources, their labels, classification statements and their referents remain distinct in the adopted profile. SKOS does not automatically make a concept an OWL domain universal, but also permits dual typing; no global disjointness is imposed. Web Annotation classifying/tagging are motivation instances, not classes equivalent to Riskium assertions/tags. RiskScenarioSpecification remains distinct from its analytical case and actual occurrence. A RiskSourceReference remains distinct from a claimed contributor and does not establish causation.

The old model has no explicit generalization_set_policy field. This packet does not manufacture an old set policy from that absence. The current policy and published qualification are separate evidence routes. This is a documentary contextual review; no independent semantic approval of all retained set criteria is implied.
context_guard_note: Shared parenthood does not create a blanket set or independently validate retained criteria. A documentary artifact is not automatically an evidential participant. Task readiness and local operational admission remain distinct from analytical RiskCase existence.
